## Pretty-printed text becomes the default output on every interaction surface. — 2026-08-01 (parent 4bbca07122de)

**Introduced a new trie/render module as a shared plain-text envelope renderer, making formatted output the default across all CLI query commands and the MCP server.**

A new `trie/render` module provides `render_envelope` and its helpers — `_symbol_record`, `_render_value`, `_is_chain`, `_squeeze`, `_prose_block`, `PROSE_KEYS`, and `_RECORD_KEYS` — turning raw dict envelopes into compact human-readable text: symbol dicts become single-line headers with collapsed signatures, call chains join with arrows, and prose/markdown fields (`story`, `usage_story`, `narrative`, etc.) print verbatim instead of JSON-escaped.

`_print_plain` in `trie/cli` now delegates to `render_envelope` rather than `json.dumps`. All eight query commands — `grep_str_cmd`, `grep_entry_points_cmd`, `grep_symbol_cmd`, `grep_symbol_neighbours_cmd`, `explain_symbol_cmd`, `explain_symbol_refs_cmd`, `trace_flow_cmd`, and `explain_flow_cmd` — gain a `--json` flag for the raw envelope while emitting formatted text by default.

In `trie/mcp_server`, `build_server` registers query tools through the new `_textified` wrapper (which preserves name, docstring, and signature for FastMCP schema via `__wrapped__`), putting rendered text on the wire; edit-pipeline tools (`patch_list`, `write_file`) stay structured. New tests in `test_render` and `test_mcp` pin the renderer contract and the wire-format split.
